svg.title: PID-Controlled Plant simulation
svg.desc: Simulation over 20 time units. Three panels show position against the captured reference input, velocity, and integral error. Shading identifies linear, high-saturation, and low-saturation modes. Eleven switches visit all three modes. The integral continues changing during saturation, and there are no state resets.
